official.application_route: Apply online via the Ministry's Study in Saudi platform (studyinsaudi.sa / studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) or the chosen public university's admission application during its published window, or through the Saudi Cultural Attache or Saudi Embassy in the applicant's country
official.citizenship_residency: Non-Saudi nationality required; external scholarships are for non-Saudi students from outside the Kingdom, while internal scholarships serve non-Saudis residing in the Kingdom with a legal residency
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is specifically for non-Saudi international students (external scholarships) from outside the Kingdom, and for non-Saudi legal residents of the Kingdom (internal scholarships)
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: All available specialisations are open except health and medical specialisations at the post-secondary stage
official.duration: Programme length follows the degree studied (Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers - Bachelor - Higher Diploma - Master's - PhD); the Ministry sets age ceilings of 25 for undergraduate and Arabic-language institute study, 30 for master's and 35 for doctoral study
official.description: The Saudi Ministry of Education runs a government scholarship programme that lets non-Saudi students from outside the Kingdom study in the Kingdom's public universities, which number 27, with sponsorship provided free of charge and without tuition fees. Awards are granted as full free scholarships with full benefits, partial scholarships (a seat only, or a seat and housing), or paid grants, according to rules each educational institution's council sets. Students from more than 200 countries study in Saudi universities, and applications follow each university's published opening dates for the academic year.
official.program_type: Government scholarship (external scholarship for non-Saudi students from outside the Kingdom)
official.english_requirement: No IELTS/TOEFL score is published on the Ministry's page; the Study in Saudi platform lists each programme's language of instruction (e.g. Arabic, or Arabic | English), and the long-term study visa requires proof of proficiency in the language of study, except for those wishing to study Arabic. Individual universities set their own language requirements.

not_confirmed: fixed central deadline (the Ministry states each university sets its own opening date per academic year)
verification.notes: Coverage, benefit tiers, eligibility, documents and application routes confirmed on the Ministry of Education programme page and the official Study in Saudi platform (homepage calendar, Visa & Pathways guide, FAQ, programme detail pages). The awarding body publishes no monetary figure for the monthly stipend, arrival reward or ticket allowance, so all amount fields remain null rather than being sourced from any third party.

applicant_utility.summary: You do not submit a separate scholarship form: admission to a Saudi public university through the Study in Saudi platform (or the university's own window) is the scholarship application, and the tier you receive - full, partial or paid - is decided by the receiving institution's council, not by you. Tuition is waived for scholarship students, and a full award adds a monthly stipend, housing, medical insurance and annual travel tickets, while a partial award can reduce this to a seat only. The published Second Semester 2026 window closed on 6 October 2026, and health or medical specialisations are excluded at post-secondary level, so timing and specialisation choice matter as much as grades.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Upper-secondary graduates for the bachelor's track (ages 17-25) and early-career postgraduates (master's under 30, PhD under 35) from outside the Kingdom who can produce attested documents and a home-country police clearance.
application_readiness_checklist: Register on the Study in Saudi platform and complete your profile before any window opens - nationality, passport and residency numbers cannot be changed after you submit an application
Attest your academic certificates with the authorities your target university specifies; programme pages make the diploma (and test scores such as SAT where required) mandatory attachments
Obtain a certificate of absence of precedents from your own country's security services and a medical report proving freedom from infectious diseases
Check whether your home government must approve study in the Kingdom, and secure that approval early if it does
Open each programme's listing and confirm its scholarship tier (Full / Partial / Paid) and language of instruction before choosing, since partial tiers can be seat-only
Keep your passport valid at least 6 months beyond your intended entry date for the visa stage
common_rejection_risks: Applications are rejected when one or more of the programme or institution's admission requirements are not met - missing or unattested certificates are the classic trigger
Falling below programme-specific thresholds such as the SAT score of at least 1010, minimum grades, or the GPA needed to remain in a distinguished track after the first common year
Already holding another scholarship from a Saudi institution, or a prior dismissal from one, both of which are disqualifying
Being outside the published age ceilings for the level sought (25 bachelor, 30 master's, 35 PhD)
Applying for health or medical specialisations, which the Ministry excludes at the post-secondary stage
Missing the short window: platform semester windows run only about three weeks and each university sets its own opening date
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: A partial (type B) award can be seat-only and type C awards are paid grants, and anything marketed as Paid Study on the platform states the student bears all tuition and living costs, so those tiers carry the full cost of tuition, housing and living. Even full-award holders still fund personal expenses, and the study visa itself requires proof of financial ability or a financial guarantee before entry.
document_audit: Your passport number is locked once an application is submitted; correct passport errors before you apply
Basic data such as residency number, passport or Gulf ID number, gender and nationality cannot be updated after submission, while qualification data can
Certificates must be attested by the authorities each university names, and the good-conduct certificate must be issued by your own country's security services
The long-term study visa requires a medical report proving freedom from infectious diseases, plus medical insurance for the holder and dependents
Some programmes demand test attachments (for example the distinguished track at King Saud University requires the SAT score) before the application is even considered complete
alerts: The platform blocks applicants who already hold a scholarship - a student cannot receive two scholarships for the same academic degree
The last published central window (Second Semester 2026) ran only 16 September to 6 October 2026; because universities set their own opening dates, the next window can appear with little notice
Health and medical specialisations are excluded for post-secondary study under this scheme, so redirect towards other fields early if that is your ambition
Do not budget on the assumption of a full award: benefit level varies by university and can be partial, so verify the tier on your programme's listing
Under the published condition, female students not covered by a scholarship or regular residence must have a mahram under the applicable instructions
The study visa requires a scholarship offer from a Saudi university first; after arrival, the student can obtain a free residence permit for the duration of study based on a university letter
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online through the Study in Saudi platform (or the university's admission portal, Saudi Cultural Attache or Embassy where applicable) -> the receiving institution reviews the admission application -> the institution and the Ministry of Education complete the final admission procedures -> the decision appears on the platform, and the visa and residence steps follow the university letter.
